Users can still trade the spot trading pair's base and quote assets on other trading pair(s) that are available on Binance."}]},{"node":"text","text":"
"},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Binance will terminate Spot Trading Bots services for the aforementioned spot trading pairs at "},{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"2026-10-02 03:00 (UTC)"}]},{"node":"text","text":" where applicable.
